sample_mapping_evidence: Original GEO overall design explicitly states four distinct AIH patients; four unpooled mRNA V1..V4 records. Selected memory CD4 preparation limits cell-type coverage. Receptor/liver/other study assays are not additional independent blood specimens.

source_processing: CellRanger v7.0.1 multi function to process RNA across sequencing lanes into a single set of  barcodes.tsv.gz, features.tsv.gz and matrix.mtx.gz as well as identify the V(d)J sequences from the TCR library.

The two data sets from cellranger, RNA and TCR have been processed with a custom script using Seurat 4.1, harmony 1.1.0 and azimut 0.4.5 as main packges, full script at : https://gitlab.univ-nantes.fr/braud-m-3/amr053-scrnaseq-tcr.git
Supplementary files format and content: CellRanger output files: barcodes.tsv.gz, features.tsv.gz, matrix.mtx.gz, filtered_contig_annotations.csv
Supplementary files format and content: Seurat Analysis output : AmR053_harmony_azimuth_V4regRB.rds

title: Human PBMCs from AILD AIH patients, GEX Sample 1
treatment_protocol_ch1: After PBMCs extraction and staining, PD-1+CD45RA-CXCR5- CD4 T cells were sorted on BD FACSAriaII.
extract_protocol_ch1: Cells were counted, centrifuged (500g, 5 min, 4°c) then resuspended at the recommended dilution for a 20000 cell loading per sample onto a Next GEM Chip K (PN-1000286) and run on a Chromium Single Cell Controller using the Chromium Single Cell 5′ V2 Next GEM single cell kit (PN-1000263) according to the manufacturer's instructions. Gex and VDJ-TCR libraries were then prepared (PN-1000190, PN-1000252, PN-1000215 also from 10X genomics)

The cell hashing protocol described by Stoeckius et al  (Stoeckius et al.,2017)  was used to generate a hashtag oligo (HTO) library, adapted with a 5’v2 immune profiling protocol with TCR. https://citeseq.files.wordpress.com/2019/02/cite-seq_and_hashing_protocol_190213.pdf
description: Sample 1 : GEX (3' mRNA) library: read1 file contains cell barcode and UMI; read2 file contains transcript
data_processing: CellRanger v7.0.1 multi function to process RNA across sequencing lanes into a single set of  barcodes.tsv.gz, features.tsv.gz and matrix.mtx.gz as well as identify the V(d)J sequences from the TCR library.

The two data sets from cellranger, RNA and TCR have been processed with a custom script using Seurat 4.1, harmony 1.1.0 and azimut 0.4.5 as main packges, full script at : https://gitlab.univ-nantes.fr/braud-m-3/amr053-scrnaseq-tcr.git
